mapper.insert: INSERT into view_log ( user_id, content_id, viewed_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{contentId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT content_id as contentId, title as title, description as description, author as author, type as type, toon_url as toonUrl, created_at as createdAt, cp_name as cpName, right_member as rightMember, views as views, left_member as leftMember FROM contents WHERE content_id = #{contentId}

SELECT e.episode_id AS episodeId, e.content_id AS contentId, e.episode_number AS episodeNumber, e.sub_title AS subTitle, e.content_path AS contentPath, e.price AS price, e.created_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN f.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS isFavorite FROM episodes e LEFT JOIN favorites f ON e.content_id = f.content_id AND f.user_id = #{userId} WHERE e.content_id = #{contentId}

SELECT c.content_id AS contentId, c.title AS title, c.description AS description, c.author AS author, c.type AS type, c.toon_url AS toonUrl, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.cp_name AS cpName, c.right_member AS rightMember, c.views AS views, c.left_member AS leftMember FROM favorites f JOIN contents c ON f.content_id = c.content_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_favorite FROM favorites WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( episode_id, comment_text, created_at, profile_img, user_id, content_id, parent_id, nickname ) SELECT #{episodeId}, #{commentText}, NOW(), #{profileImg}, #{userId}, #{contentId}, #{parentId}, u.nickname FROM users u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT comment_id AS commentId, episode_id AS episodeId, comment_text AS commentText, created_at AS createdAt, profile_img AS profileImg, user_id AS userId, content_id AS contentId, parent_id AS parentId, like_count AS likeCount, nickname AS nickname FROM comments
